pages.text: Surrounding a normal sapling with T0 Panakeia Reed creates an Alchetree sapling. When an Alchetree grows, it produces special leaves, and breaking those leaves can yield Panakeia.
You can also raise the Alchetree's tier by surrounding an Alchetree sapling with Panakeia Cubes of the next higher tier. Higher-tier Alchetrees can yield higher-tier Panakeia.
